VARCHAR and TEXT have identical read performance in Postgres. Both use varlena storage with the same compression and toasting behavior. The only difference is the length constraint enforced at write time.

For read performance, pick based on your constraint need: VARCHAR(2000) if you want the database to enforce the limit, TEXT if the length is truly unbounded. Not on performance grounds.
